_om: Skjæra in English (Maggie, rusj.no/en/maggie/) – Kim's game with a thieving magpie. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js; the things are in data.en/ting.json. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Skjæra tok en fjær – {fjaer} igjen: The magpie took a feather – {fjaer} left
Skjæra tok den siste fjæra: The magpie took the last feather
Den som først roper hva som mangler, får: The first to shout out what's missing gets the point.
Den som først roper alt som mangler, får: The first to shout out everything that's missing gets the point.
Hva tok skjæra? Rop det ut!: What did the magpie take? Shout it out!
Den stakk av med alt sammen. Prøv en gan: It got away with the lot. Have another go!
Skjæra – Hvor langt kommer du?\n🪶 Jeg hu:
Maggie – How far can you get?
🪶 I remembered a board of {n} things – every single one! Can you remember more?

Maggie – How far can you get?
🪶 I remembered a board of {n} things. Can you remember more?
Se godt på tingene. Så kommer skjæra og: Look closely at the things. Then the magpie swoops in and steals something! Can you spot what's missing?
Tingene vises i noen sekunder. Prøv å hu: The things are shown for a few seconds. Try to remember them all.
Skjæra flyr forbi og tar med seg noe. På: The magpie swoops past and takes something with it. On the hard boards it jumbles up the rest too.
Trykk på det skjæra tok. Du har like man: Tap what the magpie took. You get as many guesses as there are things missing.
Si tingene høyt mens du ser på dem. Da h: Say the things out loud while you look at them. That helps you remember them.
Nivåer: Samle stjerner på tolv nivåer. E: Levels: collect stars on twelve levels. A round with no mistakes earns a star.
Hvor langt kommer du? Brettet vokser med: How far can you get? The board grows by one thing every time you find everything. Miss, and the magpie takes a feather – and you only have three.
Rop det ut: Alle ser på det samme brette: Shout it out: everyone looks at the same board. The first to shout out everything that's missing gets the point.
Etter tur: Alle får hvert sitt brett, og: Taking turns: everyone gets their own board, and every thing you find scores a point. If it's a tie at the end, there's a tie-break.
Look closely at the Christmas decorations.
Skjæra stjeler julepynt og julegodt: The magpie steals Christmas decorations and treats
Finner du alt skjæra tok, kommer det én: Find everything the magpie took, and one more thing joins the board.
Bommer du, tar skjæra en fjær. Etter tre: Miss, and the magpie takes a feather. After three, it's over.
Ingen rekord ennå – sett den første!: No record yet – set the first one!
🌀 = skjæra roter til brettet. En runde u: 🌀 = the magpie jumbles up the board. A round with no mistakes earns a star.
Hver sin tur med mobilen: Each takes a turn with the phone
Legg mobilen så alle ser. Den som først: Put the phone where everyone can see it. The first to shout out what the magpie took gets the point.
Dere sender mobilen rundt. Alle får hver: Pass the phone round. Everyone gets their own board.
It gets a little harder as you go.
Hvor mange poeng det spilles til: How many points you play to
Står det likt til slutt, blir det omkamp: If it's a tie at the end, there's a tie-break.
De andre kan se på – men ikke hviske!: The others can watch – but no whispering!
Ingen runder uten feil denne gangen. Prø: No rounds without a mistake this time. Try again – you can do it!
Tre runder uten en eneste feil!: Three rounds without a single mistake!
Et brett med alle 30 tingene, og du fant: A board with all 30 things, and you found everything. The magpie gives up!
Skjæra tok alle fjærene før du klarte et: The magpie took all the feathers before you cleared a board. Try again – you can do it!

Du husket et brett med {n} ting..one: You remembered a board of {n} thing.
Du husket et brett med {n} ting..other: You remembered a board of {n} things.

Du husket et brett med {n} ting før skjæ.one: You remembered a board of {n} thing before the magpie took the last feather.
Du husket et brett med {n} ting før skjæ.other: You remembered a board of {n} things before the magpie took the last feather.

Neste runde blir litt vanskeligere …: The next round gets a little harder …
{navn} står likt. Dere får ett brett til: {navn} are level. You each get one more board – and now it's harder.
The boards you've cleared still count.
Dere går rett til kåringen med poengene: You'll go straight to the results with the points you have now.
